libraries.name: SPICE essentials
libraries.description: Standard onetransistor symbols with SPICE models, sources, and model/analysis definitions. Includes generic teaching models and a 741-style behavioral model.

libraries.name: Digital logic
libraries.description: Generic single-unit digital symbols based on the selected NAND: yellow bodies, hidden VCC/VSS power pins and native inversion/clock shapes. Simulation models are configured separately.
